Showcase · 2026-08-29 · @rtc/client-react-native vs docs/design/mobile/v1

How far the React Native client sits from the mobile-v1 prototype, screen by screen

Left column: the committed simctl golden at b491d4828 — the app, framed in its real HUD chrome since Phase 0 (PR #588) and, for the boot scenes, the real boot sequence since Phase 0b, rendered over a static fake ViewModel with motion frozen. Right column: the frozen prototype reference shot from the deviation corpus. Both are 1206×2622, the iPhone 17 logical viewport, so the panels are directly comparable. The prototype cannot change, so a difference is never a failure — it is a measure of how far the app has moved from the design, and where. Verdicts are an eyeball, not a pixel metric: a pixel diff between two different renderers of different sample data measures nothing.

Module screens, worst first

The ten surfaces the fidelity pass will work, in the order it should take them. Each card names what differs; deliberate additions are called out as such so they are not mistaken for drift.

01

lock/hold

Hold-to-unlock

Far from design
  • App: the ring at a pinned 55% fill and an AUTHENTICATE ▸ label, nothing else.
  • Design: hex emblem above SESSION LOCKED, a TRADER.EI · DESK FX-7 · hh:mm:ss line, a crosshair inside the ring, AUTHENTICATING… beneath it.
  • Deliberately unframed on both sides — the design's lock has no chrome either.
02

credit/rfq-tiles

RFQ tiles

Moderate
  • Dealer names are Bank A / B / C where the design uses desk names; prices carry a $ the design omits; the best row lacks the design's ◂ BEST marker; three dealers per card vs the design's five.
  • Subtitle reads Buy | Qty: 5,000,000 where the design prints BUY · 1.0M USD · #3045.
  • The countdown ring, best-quote tint and ACCEPT halo do land. Already ledgered as the Phase 5a refinement pass.
03

equities/markets

Movers board

Moderate
  • App adds a MOVERS heading and a whole SECTORS block (Technology / Consumer / Finance / Energy chips) the design does not have; RANK BY chips are rectangles where the design's are pills; a selected-row highlight the design has no equivalent of.
  • Sparklines are the fake's perfect sine waves — harness data. Row anatomy (rank · symbol · name · sparkline · price · change pill) matches.
04

analytics/dashboard

P&L · pair P&L · net exposure

Moderate
  • Layout and the three cards match. Number formatting does not: +$9.7k / +12k / Δ -3k / 600S where the design prints +$29,672 / +421.1K / Δ +4.2K / 12S.
  • Exposure bubbles are fewer and larger (five currencies, pinned book) — data, not layout. The design's P&L line is jagged tick-history; the app's is the fixture's smooth 12-point series.
05

shell/appearance

Appearance sheet

Moderate
  • The app's sheet is taller and carries more — a 3-way Dark / Light / System segment, a Motion section with an Aurora / Rays picker, a Power-saver ladder (Off / Calm / Freeze) and SIGN OUT. The design has a DARK / LIGHT pill, six skin cards, one Ambient toggle and Replay. The extra rows are deliberate product surface, not drift.
  • Typography: sans labels (Skin, Motion, Power saver) where the design is mono-uppercase throughout; card labels are sans-caps vs the design's mono.
  • Framed over the Rates grid as the design shows it — but the app's sheet is tall enough that the grid behind is not visible.

Sell-side ticket

Close

  • Subtitle prints a raw 2,000,000 and no client where the design abbreviates 3.0M USD · ADAPTIVE ASSET MGMT; the CTA is flat cyan vs the design's cyan→green gradient; the app adds a PASS link and omits the design's YOUR QUOTES heading beneath the card.

rates/grid

Spot tile grid

Close

08

equities/trade

Trade view

Close
  • Phase 2 (2026-08-29): the DEPTH ladder and the three mono headings are gone. The screen is now the design's stack — symbol chips, one instrument card (symbol with name · exchange inline, price + pct in the change colour, the candle chart inside the card over faint 32px rules), the ticket (SELL / BUY outlined toggles, boxed MKT | LMT, 100 · 500 · 1K · 5K chips, a LIMIT PX stepper seeded from the last price, a full-width BUY 500 AAPL · @ 191.90 CTA), and POSITIONS beneath in Phase 1's cards.
  • The design's CTA is a vertical gradient of the side colour; the app's is flat. The fixture pins BUY · LMT · 500; production starts at qty 0 / MKT with no chip lit (a client-core default, left as is).
09

equities/blotter

Orders + positions blotters

Close
  • Phase 1 (2026-08-29): the six-column table with the mid-word status wrap (PARTIALL/YFILLED) and the Orders/Positions toggle are gone. ORDERS and POSITIONS now stack on one scroll as the design's bordered card rows — symbol over a BUY LMT side+type sub-label, qty, price, a boxed status pill (filled → positive, open → amber, cancelled/rejected → negative); positions print signed qty, @avg and a compacted +1.3K P&L coloured by sign.
  • The web-ported desk-P&L gauge and per-row sparklines were removed — the mobile design has neither. The fixture seeds five orders spanning every status to the design's three, so the app column runs longer.
10

blotter/seeded

FX blotter

Close
  • Filter chips, fills summary (6 FILLS · 3B/3S), 4-column header, row anatomy and status pills match.
  • The app prints a date under each pill (2026-07-22) where the design prints a time (18:09:14); the design's sample has 17 rows to the fixture's six.

Cross-cutting

Differences that appear in every framed pair rather than in one module — and two that look like drift but are not.

Typography
Filter chips, section labels and the appearance sheet render in the sans face where the design is mono-uppercase with wide tracking.
Status strip clock
Frozen at 09:47:03 in the app column (a harness pin); the prototype shows a live time. Not drift.
Status bar and dynamic island
Real in the app column (pinned to 09:41, full bars, charged); absent in the prototype, whose bezel draws them outside the captured element. Not drift.

Boot scenes

All eight scene ports against their prototype originals — the real BootSequence in the app column, pinned at 60% of the ramp. The scenes are close; the chrome around them is the deviation, named once below because it is the same in every pair.

  • Scene compositions match one for one — the eight canvases are ports of the eight prototype scenes, and each pair shows the same geometry at a comparable instant.
  • The boot chrome is the one deviation, and it is the same in all eight pairs. The app centres its block mid-screen, over the scene: the wordmark, TACTICAL TRADING OPERATING SYSTEM · v4.0, SEQUENCE · CORE, a 220px progress bar with a 60% readout, and a plain SKIP ▸ text link. The design pins a bottom block clear of the scene: the wordmark, MOBILE OS // SEQ n/8 · CORE SYNC, a full-width rail, ▸ STREAM FX·CREDIT·EQ, and a boxed SKIP ▸ pill bottom-right. Since Phase 0b (2026-08-29) the app column is the real BootSequence, so this is the app, not the harness.
  • The scene's top-left telemetry (CORE SYNC · GLOBAL MESH) sits under the iOS clock and dynamic island in the app column. The prototype draws it at the same height — its capture simply has no status bar — so on a device the app's is the one that collides. An inset is a fidelity item for the boot phase.
  • Each app frame is one pinned instant (elapsedSec = 2.52); the prototype shot is whichever instant the corpus captured. Timing differences are not drift.

How this was made. A Claude Code session composed each app golden beside its prototype shot with ImageMagick, read every pair, and wrote the verdicts and notes by hand; the thumbnails here are 300px, 256-colour reductions of the committed PNGs, inlined so the page is one file. It is a companion, not a source of truth: the generated pair table is docs/design/mobile/v1/reference-shots/DRIFT.md (pnpm prototype-shots:drift), the pending work is the "RN prototype-fidelity pass" entry in docs/STATUS.md, and the finding that the comparison had been measuring the harness rather than the app is T48 in docs/rn-open-items.md. Regenerate by re-running the session's builder against a newer golden set after each module phase lands — the verdicts are the part that has to be re-read, not re-run.
